# Build an animated correlation bubble scatter plot

Plots every country as a bubble, at its value of `indicator1` (x) and of
`indicator2` (y), sized by its population and colored by its region,
animated over `Year`, for the Scatterplot tab. The region comes from
`country_code`, by matching its `Short Name` to the `Country Name` of
`mfi`; a country whose names differ there has no region and is left out,
as is a country-year without both values and the population.

## Usage

``` r
plot_cor(mfi, country_code, indicator1, indicator2, font_style)
```

## Arguments

- mfi:

  Data frame of World Bank indicator values (long format, with
  `Country Name`, `Indicator Name`, `Year`, `value` columns). Must also
  contain a `"Population, total"` indicator, used for bubble sizing.

- country_code:

  Data frame mapping countries to region, with columns `Country Code`,
  `Short Name`, `Region`.

- indicator1:

  Character. Indicator name plotted on the x-axis.

- indicator2:

  Character. Indicator name plotted on the y-axis.

- font_style:

  A `plotly` font list for the layout of the chart; the app passes
  [font_style](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemworldbank/reference/font_style.md).

## Value

A `plotly` htmlwidget.

## Examples

``` r
plot_cor(
  mfi,
  country_code,
  indicator1 = "Mortality rate, adult, male (per 1,000 male adults)",
  indicator2 = "Mortality rate, infant (per 1,000 live births)",
  font_style = font_style
)
```
